At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were '''ambushed''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on an [[Unidentified green planet (Wookiees)|unidentified green planet]]. However, the Imperials' plans turned against them when a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors emerged from the woods and engaged battle. Under the lead of Chewbacca, the Wookiees closed in on the Empire's troops before leading them away into the forest. Upon the Empire's defeat, Solo and Chewbacca got back into their [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and left the planet.<ref name="WOFW" />
